guidance.explanation: For a proved defective-goods complaint, the Act provides possible remedies including replacement or return of the price. A refund is not an automatic or guaranteed outcome.

The e-commerce rules restrict refusal to take back goods or refund a paid price in specified situations, including defective goods or goods not matching what was advertised or agreed. This is not a universal change-of-mind refund right.

The Act provides for complaints to be heard on affidavit and documentary evidence. Preserving genuine purchase and communication records is useful preparation, not proof that the allegations are established.

guidance.explanation: E-commerce rules stated schedule se late delivery par refunds address karte hain, force majeure exception ke saath. Non-delivery par rule apply karne se pehle promised schedule aur order history check karni hogi.

E-commerce rules kuch situations mein goods wapas lene ya paid price refund karne se refusal ko restrict karte hain, jaise defective ya advertised/agreed features se alag goods. Yeh har purchase par change-of-mind refund right nahi hai.
